C.A. NO.3195/2016 (@ SLP (C) No.29714/2013)  and
C.A. NO.3196/2016 (@ SLP (C) No.17358/2014)
1.   Leave granted.
2.
The issue raised in these cases pertains to the renewal 
of licence of the apellants, by the Railways.
3.
It is fairly submitted by the learned counsel on both
sides that the issue in principle, is covered by the decision
of this Court in Civil Appeal Nos. 618-620 of 2016 decided on 
29th January,  2016.   Therefore,  these  appeals  are  allowed 
directing  the  Railways  to  take  the  required  action  in  the 

Page 2
JUDGMENT
light of the said judgment, within six weeks.    
4.  The  impugned  judgments  are  set  aside  and  appeals  are 
allowed as above.
W.P. Nos. 848/2014, 207/2015 & 177/2015
The  issue   on  renewal  of  licence  in  principle,  is 
covered by the decision of this Court in Civil Appeal Nos. 
618-620 of 2016 decided on 29th January, 2016.  Therefore, 
these writ petitions are disposed of with direction to the 
Railways to take the required further steps in the light of 
the judgment dated 29th January, 2016, within six weeks.
